name: Ethel Elizabeth Quinn (Schriefer)
notable_stories: She was the biological grandmother of Barbara and Chuck
After her death, the children were moved to the household of her brother, John Quinn
Her death triggered the final transition of the McKeldin children into the Quinn household on Nicklas Avenue
milestones: Buried at New Cathedral Cemetery, Baltimore
sources: Barbara McKeldin Adams, "Barbara McKeldin Adams - A Memoir" (privately printed)
Ancestry.com, U.S., Newspapers.com Obituary Index (Baltimore Sun and Evening Sun death notices)
Ancestry.com, public member tree "Quinn Family Tree" (tree 11167102)
notes: Barbara identifies her as her maternal grandmother.
Daughter of Bernard Quinn and Emily M. (Lynn), both born in Ireland; in 1910 the family lived in District 3, Harford County, Maryland.

CORRECTION: born 13 Nov 1900 at Fallston, Harford County, and baptized 2 Dec 1900 at St John's Church (Quinn Family Tree on Ancestry; aged 9 in 1910, 29 in 1930, 39 in 1940; Find a Grave gives 1901), and died 9 Apr 1952 in Baltimore, per her death notice (Baltimore Sun, 10 Apr 1952). She was about 51, not in her early sixties as Barbara remembered.
